All three of us start at the same time. Source of truth is `SPEC.md`; section numbers point into it.
Branch: `johnny/<feature>`. Only edit files you own. Ask in chat before touching anyone else's.

## Hour 0: foundation slice (parallel with Jerry and Hang)

- [ ] **While Jerry scaffolds (~10 min):** create the Auth0 tenant (Regular Web App) and the Tiger service `mise-db` + fork `mise-test`. Put the secrets in team chat or a password manager, never in git.
- [ ] `db/migrations/0001_init.sql`, `0002_timescale.sql` (§5.2–§5.3) + `scripts/migrate.mjs`. Apply to both DBs (0.6)
- [ ] `src/lib/`: `env.ts` (Zod, §8), `auth0.ts`, `src/proxy.ts`, `current-user.ts` (`requireUser`), `db.ts` (postgres.js, `max: DB_POOL_MAX`, `ssl:'require'`)
- [ ] `src/lib/units.ts` + tests (§5.4), `src/lib/gtin.ts` + tests
- [ ] `.env.example`
- [ ] Resolve §17 items 4, 5, 6, 7, 11

Push these files as soon as they work; Jerry and Hang import `requireUser` and `db`.

## Workstream B: Pantry, Products & Nutrition (§18.3)

**Owns:** `src/features/{scan,pantry,nutrition}/**`, `src/server/{products,vision,pantry}/**`, `src/server/nutrition/daily*`, `src/app/(app)/{onboarding,settings,today,pantry}/**`, `src/app/api/{me,products,vision,pantry,meals,nutrition}/**`, `public/zxing/**`
**Consumes:** Hang's `server/diet` allergen map, read-only. Use a stub list until it lands.
**Provides:** a real pantry. Hang's recipe matching and finish-cooking read `pantry_items`.

- [ ] 1. `/api/me` + onboarding + settings (F1)
- [ ] 2. Scanner component (F2)
- [ ] 3. Lookup orchestrator: dataandapis + OFF adapters, cache, single-flight, fixtures (F2, §10.1–§10.2)
- [ ] 4. `/api/vision/label` + ProductForm (F3)
- [ ] 5. `/api/vision/expiry` + date assembly + CFIA regex (F4)
- [ ] 6. Pantry list, CRUD, events (F5)
- [ ] 7. Meals API, today + history endpoints, rings, 7-day chart, Log Food dialog (F15)
- [ ] 8. Per-item nutrition display (F10 item part)

**Done:** F1–F5 and F15 ACs pass, plus the §14.2 products/date/units tests.

Good news on the technical question: **no, you don't need real Auth0 access at all** for local dev, regardless of who holds the tenant credentials. Look at `src/lib/auth0.ts:9`:

```ts
export const authDisabled = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && !process.env.AUTH0_DOMAIN;
```

If `AUTH0_DOMAIN` isn't set locally, the app auto-logs you in as a fake "Demo cook" user (`current-user.ts`'s `DEV_USER`) and skips Auth0 entirely — `src/proxy.ts` even short-circuits the middleware when this is on. So you can hit `/today`, `/recipes`, `/pantry`, anything behind login, without your friend's Auth0 dashboard access. (Your real `.env` currently has `AUTH0_DOMAIN` set, so you'd need to comment it out locally to flip this on — just don't commit that.)

One thing worth flagging though: I pulled up this repo's own team-assignment docs (`hang.md`, `johnny.md`, `jerry.md`) to check, and "what happens after login" — `/today` and `/onboarding` — are explicitly **Johnny's** owned files (Workstream B), while your area (Workstream C) is `src/features/recipes/**`, `src/app/(app)/recipes/**`, `src/app/api/{recipes,cook}/**`. The team rule in those docs is "only edit files you own, ask in chat before touching anyone else's." So technically you can build/test those pages, but if you mean actually implementing their content, that'd be worth a heads-up to Johnny first rather than me just diving in.

So: what specifically did you want to move on to — your own recipes/cook work, or did you want help on the `/today`/`/onboarding` stubs themselves?
